recipes.name: Pancakes
steps: In a large bowl, whisk together flour, baking powder, salt, and sugar.
In another bowl, whisk milk, egg, and melted butter together.
Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir until just combined (a few lumps are fine).
Heat a lightly oiled griddle or frying pan over medium-high heat.
Pour or scoop batter onto the griddle, using about 1/4 cup per pancake.
Cook until bubbles form on top, then flip and cook until golden brown on the other side.
Serve warm with syrup, fruit, or your favorite toppings.

recipes.name: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio
steps: Cook spaghetti in salted boiling water until al dente. Reserve 1/2 cup pasta water, then drain.
While the pasta cooks, gently heat olive oil in a large pan over low heat.
Add sliced garlic and red pepper flakes, and cook slowly until garlic is golden (not browned).
Add the drained spaghetti to the pan, tossing to coat. Add a splash of reserved pasta water to loosen.
Season with salt, toss in chopped parsley, and serve immediately with parmesan if desired.

recipes.name: Chicken Fried Rice
steps: Heat 1 tbsp vegetable oil in a large wok or pan over high heat. Cook the diced chicken until fully cooked, then set aside.
Add remaining oil, then scramble the eggs in the same pan until just set. Set aside with the chicken.
Add garlic and mixed vegetables to the pan, stir-frying for 2-3 minutes.
Add the cold rice, breaking up any clumps, and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes until heated through.
Return the chicken and eggs to the pan. Add soy sauce and sesame oil, tossing everything together.
Garnish with green onions and serve hot.

recipes.name: Guacamole
steps: Cut the avocados in half, remove the pit, and scoop the flesh into a bowl.
Mash the avocado with a fork, leaving it as chunky or smooth as you like.
Add lime juice and salt, and mix well.
Fold in onion, cilantro, tomatoes, and garlic.
Taste and adjust salt or lime juice as needed. Add cayenne for a bit of heat.
Serve immediately with tortilla chips.

recipes.name: Classic Pancake-Free Omelette
ingredients: Optional fillings: diced ham, spinach, mushrooms, peppers
steps: Whisk the eggs in a bowl with salt and pepper until well combined.
Heat butter in a non-stick pan over medium heat until melted and foaming.
Pour in the eggs, swirling the pan to coat the bottom evenly.
As the edges set, gently push them toward the center, tilting the pan so uncooked egg flows to the edges.
When the eggs are mostly set, sprinkle cheese and any fillings on one half.
Fold the omelette in half and slide it onto a plate. Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Lentil Soup
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add onion and carrot, and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic, cumin, and turmeric, and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the lentils and vegetable broth. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 20-25 minutes until lentils are soft.
Blend partially or fully for a smoother texture, if desired.
Season with salt and pepper, and finish with a squeeze of lemon juice before serving.
